name: AbuseIPDB (API v2 check and web pages)
tier_rationale: Established company (Marathon Studios, Inc.) with published terms, a privacy policy and paid plans (A8 trusted); P157 final condition 2: 'Registry: tier trusted, terms key-terms'.

reliability.justification: Community abuse reports aggregated into a confidence score; single reporters and CGNAT/mobile addresses produce false positives (P157 cond 4: >= 3 distinct reporters for 'malicious', Mobile ISP capped at low).

abuseipdb.description: AbuseIPDB API v2 key (Key header; check endpoint only, never report)
abuseipdb.plan_hint: AbuseIPDB's terms forbid commercial use of Free plans and several free accounts per organisation: record 'business' (key_plans.abuseipdb) only for a Basic or higher paid plan held by the company (P157 cond 2)

check.title: AbuseIPDB API v2 check (GET /api/v2/check?ipAddress=&maxAgeInDays=90, never verbose) and check-block (<= /24)

terms.quote: Licence (legal floor): AbuseIPDB's terms (verified 2026-11-26) forbid commercial use of Free plans and several free accounts per organisation. Under corporate it runs only with a Basic or higher paid plan recorded by legal (key_plans.abuseipdb='business'); otherwise SKIPPED reason_code 'licence' with the manual AbuseIPDB link.

check.notes: Quote: binding council text (P157 cond 2). Read-only: GET /api/v2/check and /api/v2/check-block only; report, bulk-report and clear-address are never called (P157 cond 1). 'verbose' is never sent, so report comments (free text that may hold personal data) are never fetched, cached or stored. Without a key: 401 errors[].detail 'Authentication failed...' (research). 429 'Daily rate limit of 1000 requests exceeded' = QUOTA, other 429 = RATE_LIMITED. Daily limits per plan: Standard 1,000 checks / 100 block checks; Basic 10,000 / 1,000 (docs 2026-11-26). Provider data is not redistributed (x_redistribution).
check.licensed_alternative: An AbuseIPDB Basic (or higher) plan held by the company and recorded as key_plans.abuseipdb = 'business'; meanwhile the manual page threat_intel_g07_p2:abuseipdb_check_ip (browser only: Cloudflare check for scripts).

web_links.title: AbuseIPDB check pages (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: otherwise SKIPPED reason_code 'licence' with the manual AbuseIPDB link.

web_links.notes: Quote: binding council text (P157 cond 2). www.abuseipdb.com/check/{ip} sits behind a Cloudflare challenge for scripts (research): manual opening in a browser only, never fetched by V3LUM.

x_redistribution.external_exports: verdict, link and source name only
x_redistribution.basis: P157 cond 5: provider data is not redistributed; excluded from STIX/MISP/JSON exports shared outside the company

x_quota_check_block.evidence: docs.abuseipdb.com 'API Daily Rate Limits' (2026-11-26): check-block has its own daily counter; P334 blocks are per provider, so the module counts check-block calls per day in ctx.state against the plan of setting abuseipdb_plan (default standard: 100, 80% spent) until per-endpoint budgets exist

notes: Owned by batch p2-G07-1 (P157). The key 'abuseipdb' is the legacy config.KNOWN_KEYS entry; this fragment adds the alias V3LUM_ABUSEIPDB_KEY and the plan hint. Quota: the Standard (free) plan's 1,000 checks per day at 80% (key scope); a recorded Basic plan's 10,000 replaces it when legal records the plan.
